## Works: example notebooks reach provisioned installs

A clean Works install (works-core provisioned from the catalog — any profile) had an empty
**Help → Open example…**: the notebook examples were baked into works-all only, and nothing
in the packages catalog carried them.

New catalog package **`@gcu/examples`** — all 88 example notebooks from the gallery, with
module references rewritten to resolve inside Works, filed under their real categories in
the example picker. Included in the Notebook profile (Geoscience and Everything inherit it).

Existing installs: **Tools → Set up / change profile…** and re-provision, or install
"Example notebooks" from **Tools → Library**, to pick them up.
